cells.gaps: An APC article of February 2024 calls Botswana a signatory of the Malabo Convention (BWA-003); the African Union's register of February 2026, the newer and the depositary's own, shows no signature, so it stands.
cells.note: The African Union's register of 2 February 2026 shows no signature, ratification or deposit for Botswana, and no other shared African digital text is on record, so stage 1. The APC's 2024 claim of a signature is older and outweighed by the register.
